sql_query: SELECT o.produce_name AS PRODUCE_NAME, SUM(o.sales) AS "Total Sales" FROM Orders o WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS} GROUP BY o.produce_name ORDER BY SUM(o.sales) DESC LIMIT 10
description: Top 10 produce items by total sales.

query_name: Sub-category: Return Rate, Profit Margin, Total Sales
sql_query: SELECT o.sub_category AS SUB_CATEGORY, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)=0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) END AS "Return Rate %", CASE WHEN SUM(o.sales)=0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(o.profit)/SUM(o.sales) END AS "Profit Margin", SUM(o.sales) AS "Total Sales" FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Returns r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS} GROUP BY o.sub_category ORDER BY SUM(o.sales) DESC
description: Per sub-category return rate, profit margin and total sales.

query_name: Region: Total Sales, Total Orders, Return Rate
sql_query: SELECT o.region AS REGION, SUM(o.sales) AS "Total Sales", COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS "Total Orders", CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)=0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) END AS "Return Rate %" FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Returns r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS} GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY SUM(o.sales) DESC
description: Sales, order counts and return rate by region.

query_name: Total Sales by Year and SEGMENT
sql_query: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS Year, SUM(CASE WHEN o.segment='Consumer' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS "Consumer", SUM(CASE WHEN o.segment='Corporate' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS "Corporate", SUM(CASE WHEN o.segment='Home Office' THEN o.sales ELSE 0 END) AS "Home Office" FROM Orders o WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS} GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) ORDER BY Year
description: Annual total sales split by segment.

sql_query: SELECT o.ship_mode AS SHIP_MODE, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS "Total Orders" FROM Orders o WHERE {SLICER_CONDITIONS} GROUP BY o.ship_mode ORDER BY "Total Orders" DESC
description: Count of distinct orders by shipping mode.
